meta.source: Jordan Watkins - i'd love to see AI try and recreate this
meta.edit: beat-locked, every cut within 0.15s of a music onset
meta.notes: Times after 15.9s are read from 0.15s strips, accurate to about +-0.1s.

slots.QUESTION: a lowercase rhetorical question the piece refuses to answer in words (orig: how do you communicate that you're going through a change?)
slots.QUESTION_HOOK_WORDS: first 1-3 words shown big in the opening (orig: how / do you)
slots.QUESTION_HIGHLIGHT: single word in the question that turns white (orig: you)
slots.REBUTTAL: short flat denial, no apostrophe (orig: you dont.)
slots.SHOW_LINE: the 'show, don't tell' line built word by word (orig: you just show it.)
slots.OBJECTS: 12 pixel-art sprites that represent the subject's interests (orig: vinyl, skateboard, red book, camera, black cat, gold coin, game controller, cap, heart, cash, potted plant, clapperboard)
slots.VALUE_1: one-word value with a period (orig: action.)
slots.THESIS_LEAD: line split around the hand, ending on a connective (orig: through ones / own ability to)
slots.THESIS_WORD: short uppercase word spelled one letter per cut, ideally 4 letters (orig: LOVE)
slots.THESIS_OBJECTS: one sprite per letter of THESIS_WORD (orig: heart, camera, book, vinyl)
slots.FIGURE_HEAD: live-action profile shot of the subject, rotoscoped
slots.FIGURE_HAND: live-action shot of a hand reaching up, rotoscoped

design_system.type: one lowercase rounded geometric sans (Product Sans / Gilroy-like, inferred); words end in a period; caption cap height 0.035-0.05 H
design_system.texture: heavy film grain everywhere, paper fiber on light scenes, soft vignettes, slight bloom on whites
design_system.sprites: chunky outlined pixel art, rendered as 3D-extruded objects that can tumble
design_system.figures: live-action matte filled with a heat-map gradient map (red edge, orange, yellow, white core) on black
design_system.layout: everything on the horizontal center line, y about 0.5

elements.style: red dashed cap/baseline guides, dotted selection box with handles

elements.motion: ramps to mauve then paper in the final ~0.5s

elements.style: thin white glowing ellipse around figure

elements.motion: white block cursor resolves into word ~0.15s
rotate; sequential gold-starburst flash pops ~0.15s; radial explode

elements.style: black spray-paint blobs and brush swooshes
elements.motion: splat onto sprites, turning them to black silhouettes

elements.style: changes every cut: paper, gray vignette, night, night + red glow, full signal_red, dark red
white uppercase; newest letter flashes cyan

beats.visual: handwritten hook word, snaps to huge bold type between red guides, redaction bar reveals next words, collapses to small text in a selection box, pen scribbles, then sentence types on
beats.motion: ~0.15s typographic swaps for the first 0.9s, then calm word-by-word type-on

beats.visual: cyan 4-point flare bursts in with red brush streaks; a few small OBJECTS pop in; flare settles to blue wedge at left; vignette closes to warm red-orange glow; {QUESTION_HIGHLIGHT} turns white
beats.motion: flare burst ~0.15s, then ~1.5s vignette close and warm color shift

beats.visual: FIGURE_HEAD profile in thermal fill, right half; caption left; white orbit line around head
beats.motion: blob-to-thermal resolve 0.3s; end: background ramps black to mauve to paper, figure inverts dark

beats.visual: all 12 OBJECTS in a rotating oval ring
beats.motion: assemble from blur, rotate, sequential gold flash pops, collapse sideways in the final 0.2s

beats.visual: {VALUE_3_OBJECT} + {VALUE_3_ACCENT}; red dotted ring flash at start
beats.motion: block-cursor type-on; accents pop in staggered

beats.copy: first word of {THESIS_LEAD} under a redaction bar at the end
beats.visual: ring reforms with motion blur, explodes outward, spray-paint blobs blacken sprites one by one
beats.motion: spin into radial scatter ~0.3s; ink hits on onsets

beats.visual: remaining sprites cluster, then FIGURE_HAND resolves
thermal hand reaching up at center, caption split around it
beats.motion: type-on; drifting sparks; end: background warms to mauve, hand closes

beats.visual: small red dart flies to center on paper
{THESIS_OBJECTS}[2], full red frame to dark red
letters of THESIS_WORD plus small dots scattered and rotated on paper; red pen scribble loops circle them
beats.motion: slow drift/rotate toward upright ~3s; red loops draw in ~0.15s bursts on onsets; ~1.5x push-in in final 0.2s; music near silent

pacing_rules: Keep the curve: ~2s beats for the opening, 0.5-0.9s alternating dark/light in the middle, 0.15-0.3s per letter for the thesis word, then a 3s+ near-silent coda.
Non-structural beats (S05, S07, S09, S10c) can be dropped for a shorter cut; do not speed up the others instead.
Every cut sits on a music onset.
